title: Security Composer: approve the new document look before it goes on the demo
bluf: Kam: open the attached pack and tap a, b or c. When a policy has a named target, the worksheet and change report are now titled "<target> for <customer>", and above 12 areas the policy summary's Main decisions table folds to one row per top-level area, so the summary stays on page 2 (with no named target, every output is byte-identical to today's). It passed QA gate B136 (GO WITH NOTES, one Minor: a very long title drops the footer's manifest line) and is merged to main (eddb484b), but it is not yet on the demo, which still runs 7910674f.

options.label: Approve the look; deploy to the demo
options.detail: A deploy seat ships main eddb484b (#73 B134 + #74 B135) to the demo under the push-to-demo grant, and Friday checks it there. The Minor (B136-F1, footer line budget) becomes a ticket for later.

options.label: Deploy, but change something I name in a note
options.detail: Name the change in the note (for example, a short line saying the table is folded; any new wording is yours). Friday has it made through a QA gate.

options.label: Hold the demo deploy
options.detail: Nothing goes to the demo. The change stays merged on main but not deployed.

default_action: The Composer demo stays on today's build until Kam taps.
